name: Zutto Sukishite Takusan Sukishite
original_name: ずっとすきしてたくさんすきして
source: Tokito borrows a book from the library about how to make any girl your girlfriend. Stare at them with confidence for 10 seconds, and they will become yours! But will it really work? Can anything be that simple? And who will Tokito choose? He tries it out on every girl he knows, his childhood friends Koharu and Raika, the quiet librarian Serina, the wealthy and beautiful Touma, even the mysterious girl Kokona, whom he only knows online. It really works! Now that Tokito has so many girls hearts, who will he choose to make his girlfriend?
translation: 时人从图书馆借了一本关于如何让任何女孩成为你的女朋友的书。自信地盯着它们10秒钟，它们就会成为你的！但它真的会起作用吗？事情能有这么简单吗？那么时人会选择谁呢？他对他认识的每一个女孩都进行了尝试，他的童年好友小春和赖香，安静的图书管理员塞里娜，富有而美丽的当麻，甚至是他只在网上认识的神秘女孩科科纳。真的有效！如今时人拥有这么多少女心，他会选择谁做自己的女朋友呢？
